marker.description: Two dressmaker pins (green-headed and blue-headed) placed on the facial bones/soft tissue of a cadaveric head prosection; the green pin is on the zygomatic/infraorbital region and the blue pin on the adjacent maxillary/zygomatic area.

main_question: Identify the bony structures indicated by the pins on this facial prosection.
main_explanation: The prosection shows the lateral face with the orbit, zygomatic bone and maxilla. The pins mark structures in the zygomatic/maxillary region, but the oblique angle and lack of a legible question paper make the exact intended landmark uncertain.
review_reason: The exact structures marked by the green and blue pins cannot be confidently identified from this oblique, partially out-of-focus view, and no legible handwritten question paper is present in the frame. The specimen orientation (left vs right side) is also unclear.
quality_flags: specimen partially out of frame at right edge
